Image alt: One photo shows the Taj Mahal, which is a large, grand, white marble mausoleum in India, with its rectangular reflecting pool. A second photo shows the Palace of Versailles, which is a very ornate, royal palace in France.

English caption: Figure 5.6 Just as concepts of time and space vary from culture to culture, so do the influence of religious tradition and authority on ethics and what is considered appropriate behavior, whether individual or corporate. The Taj Mahal is not the Palace of Versailles.
